caption: The drawing is composed of a large, detailed depiction of a metal tankard or cup with a single, ornate handle on its left side. The tankard has a flared lip, a broad body that tapers inward near the base, and a pronounced circular foot. The handle is curved with decorative scrollwork at the ends. On the body of the tankard, to the right, there is an engraved, decorative cartouche containing several lines of script text. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a close-up or inset of the same ornate cartouche, showing detailed scrollwork and foliage around a central circular inscription. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on cream-colored paper, with clear shading and fine detailing to give a three-dimensional appearance to the tankard and its embellishments. The composition is bordered by a faint rectangular outline, both around the main drawing and the inset.
title: Silver Mug
